description_expanded: This Alys Beach vacation rental home is ideally situated on North Charles Street giving guests a short walk to the emerging Town Center, Caliza Pool Complex and the Gulf. On the first level, two separate courtyards, each with private loggias, offer quintessential Alys Beach living. The dining room looks out to each courtyard and is defined by a vaulted timber beam ceiling. A large living room provides a sense of comfort and ease with an inviting fireplace and 13-foot ceilings. The kitchen with a center island completes the public rooms on this level. Just off the kitchen, guests will find two bedrooms, one with a king-sized bed and the other with two full-sized beds. Both bedrooms feature private baths. The primary suite with a king-sized bed is found on the second level and offers ultimate privacy for guests. A small balcony is also found off the primary suite. Parking for this home is located in two designated spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
